integrity: This is a self-contained algebraic argument conditional only on the specifically cited, previously established radicality theorem; finite checker is corroborative, not proof of unbounded n.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero for the analytic-node description; the general 2-connected-graph primality question remains open by this argument; boundary analytic germs and the Jacobian scheme are not classified; a published theorem equivalent to the cycle-family case could reduce originality.
title: Cycle-supported symmetric submaximal minors form a prime ideal
